sse_frames: 410 event_cursor_expired + snapshot_url: requires an event older than ORCHARA_RUN_EVENT_RETENTION; the development stack keeps 24h, so this branch was not exercised

error_envelope.note: every error response, including the mux's own 404/405, must use {error:{code,message,request_id[,details]}}

pagination.note: items + next_cursor, cursor/limit round-trip and a located 422 for an out-of-range limit (never a clamp)

etag_if_match.note: draft and memory: strong ETag on read, 428 for a missing If-Match, 412 for a stale one; Run cancel is deliberately ETag-free

observations.note: two documented shapes exist (decision endpoints use details.field; the rest details.header); each is located and names the header, so the gate checks identification rather than one spelling

idempotency.note: same key + same body replays the resource, same key + different body is 409, a missing key is a located 4xx that names the header

sse_frames.note: id:/event:/data: frames whose data is the event.schema envelope; Last-Event-ID replays this Run's seq. The 410 cursor-expired branch needs a retention-window fixture and is recorded as not_run.
not_run: 410 event_cursor_expired + snapshot_url: requires an event older than ORCHARA_RUN_EVENT_RETENTION; the development stack keeps 24h, so this branch was not exercised

no_generic_crud.note: no wildcard CRUD handler: an unknown path/method is refused, a random id is invisible, and the compiled route registry only contains the explicit patterns

uuid_server_generated.note: every observed resource id is a server-generated UUID; the only exception is contract-declared plain-string ids of the deployer configuration catalogs (listCredentialRefs/listModelEndpoints), derived from the OpenAPI success schema

utc_rfc3339.note: timestamps parse as RFC3339 with a UTC designator; the gate parses instead of comparing strings because RFC3339 and RFC3339Nano both occur

decimal_strings.note: money/usage fields are decimal strings, never binary floats

no_store.note: every JSON response (including successful reads) is Cache-Control: no-store
